Route is the server's routing table as one switch: each case is one method and path, read as a list, so the count is the number of routes, not depth. The restart guard goes first because it refuses every route alike.

ReviewServer.Api is one switch over every route of the window, 131 paths; I changed one route's view type. The fix is a route table of small handlers per area, which is a redesign of the server's dispatch.

The cognitive count comes from the switch's cases and their when guards, each a flat line of the routing table; nothing nests past the switch. The restart guard is one if before it that refuses every route.

resolution.reason: Both pieces are the door's one registry, the static Running list under Gate: Start adds a claude to it and Forget takes it out, Now reads it and StopAll stops what Now reads. The metric counts no static field, so it sees two pieces where every method works on the same list.

ProcessEnv is what this process runs in, read once at its start: its environment variables, and where its binary lies, from which the packaged harness, the model folder and the checkout are found. Both pieces are static reads of the process's own surroundings with no state; this change only adds the reading of BRAIN_CODE_SESSION beside CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID.

ReviewViews is a static namespace of pure functions that build the window's views from the graph; it holds no state, so the two pieces share nothing to split on. Focuses sits beside Pending and Answered, the other lists the window reads.

Read only picks the table's source, /proc where it is and ps elsewhere; each helper reads one source's format with plain guards: FromProc adds 3, walking /proc's pid folders, Stat adds 7, one process's stat fields and the read failures it survives, FromPs adds 1, and FromPs(string, int) adds 7, the ps columns that must each parse. This change only reads two more stat fields in Stat, the CPU time, and adds no decision. Inlined they would be one method that mixes two formats.

Run is brain ui's three outcomes, restart, start and open, over one hello. Await polls until brain serve answers, Fix and FixItWith build the command that fixes a held port, Serves says which build runs, and Restart and Start each send one call; inlined, they would bury the three outcomes under polling and messages.

All reads the lines and Parse turns one line into a Source. Problem names the three ways a line cannot run, as guard ifs, and Column reads one optional column. Each is a single step only All uses, and the decisions are the line format itself.

resolution.reason: Watch only starts the watcher and calls Reload; the count of 83 is the whole theme-to-stylesheet pipeline behind Reload, a chain of single-purpose steps, not a method that was cut up. AccentTokens adds 3, Apart adds 2, Color adds 2, Contrast adds 2, Follow adds 1, Hsl adds 4, Luminance adds 1, Mix adds 2, OriginTone adds 7, ParseLines adds 7, Read adds 3, Reload adds 4, Resolve adds 9, Rgb adds 4, RunCommand adds 7, Sheet adds 1, Stylesheet adds 6, SurfaceTokens adds 3, SyntaxTokens adds 3, ToldApart adds 1, YesNoTokens adds 5. Each decision lives in the step that owns its fact: a palette key's fallback in Resolve, a contrast floor in its token group, a process failure in RunCommand. Inlining them into Watch would make one 83-path method, the opposite of simpler.

Start wires claude's two streams to their readers. Listen and Error each read one stream; Event, Said, Streamed, Done and Describe each read one kind of claude's stream-json event. Inlined, Start would be one method that reads every event kind of the protocol. This change only moved its process start into ClaudeStream.Info and calls ClaudeStream's members in one style.

resolution.reason: restart is brain ui's own --restart flag: the CLI passes what it parsed and brain install passes true. The two modes share the hello and the refusal of a port that does not answer to this brain's key, so they are one command, not two.
lightModeFile is the one fact colors.toml cannot carry: whether light.mode sits beside it; the caller knows the file system, Resolve only the palette. This change added four Put lines, no path.

window is false only in the tests, whose stand-in browser records each window a test opens itself; brain serve always passes true. Taking it away changes how every ReviewServer test starts, not this server.

Sections is the entry point of two reports, Fixes and Refusals. Problems groups the period's events per worktree and id. SecondFix and ReasonBefore look up a case's context in the whole log. AddAfter leaves out an absent after, CodeBlock builds a code part and CodeOf fetches stored code through a cache. Each is one named step used by these reports alone.

Read guards, loads and builds. Load is the one step that runs the command and types the events, with its two catches for a failing command and unreadable JSON; inlined it would nest a try and a loop inside the guards.

Run parses, prints the heading and loops over the sections. Print writes one section: its title, story, note, its first 5 cases and how many more, and its lines, each an optional part. Day parses one option. Each is a step only Run uses.

Parse checks the event is an object with a type and a worktree, reads its time, then reads each field, the repo falling back to the worktree when the log names none. Field, Flag and Number each read one JSON field and guard its kind, so a malformed event never throws; each is a one-purpose reader only Parse uses.

Route is the server's door: the stranger check, then one guard per kind of caller that hands it on and returns: the command with the key to Keyed, the browser to Page, the window's launch to Launch, the window's session to Session. Its paths are those guards; each caller's calls live in its own method.

Events is the event stream's loop: take or heartbeat, end on the window's goodbye, and leave the stream and start the grace however the connection went. The catch filter names the three ways a gone connection throws, and each counts as a path. It moved unchanged from the workspace's server.

Api is the workspace's route table: one arm per call, each one line that hands to ProjectFiles or WorkspaceGit, and the when guards that keep a write to the window's origin. It is unchanged by this change but for the plumbing calls that left it for WindowServer. Splitting the table would hide it, not simplify it.

Api is the workspace's route table: one arm per call, each one line that hands to ProjectFiles or WorkspaceGit. It reads top to bottom as a list of calls; its cognitive weight is the arms' count, which dropped as the plumbing calls left for WindowServer.

Name and Title are pure functions of the root, by which the constructor names the window, its log and its WindowKind. They use no field because the fields are built from them; they belong with the workspace that names itself.

problems.symbol: brain::Brain.Code.CodeSession.Start(string, string, string, string, ClaudeFiles, Action<string>, Action<string, CodeQuestions>)

resolution.reason: Start wires one claude process: Listen reads its output until it ends and says why a session that failed ended, Event reads one stream-json event of it, and of those Began starts a turn on init, Answered reads claude's answer to an interrupt, and Ended ends a turn on its result without reading an interrupted turn as failed. Error keeps the last lines of its errors. Each helper is one event or one stream of the process; inlined they would be one method that reads two streams and parses each event. This change only hands Listen the run it reads, since a session carried over a reload as ended has none.

From reads what was written since its last read and hands back the events from the reader's position in this reading, with the text the agent is writing until this reading holds its message. Read is its one helper: it reads the bytes added and turns each whole line into events. The live text is one guard on what From holds under its lock; a helper would only move it.

Run parses the command line and picks one of its three runs, each a step with its own meaning: Serve runs the window's server; Permission is the hook's run, which reads the request and writes the decision, and Asked hands it to the server and waits, deny when the server is gone; Positionals tells the folder from the agent, Open finds or starts the server and raises its window, Started posts the start, Ended watches a session that fails at once, and Checked turns the server's refusal into the command's message. This change moves the server's start into StartServer, which Open and a reloading server's successor share, and adds no decision.

Hello adds the try and its filter, which names the ways a server that went away answers, and the check of its status; Running only reads the port and the key and checks the hello. Inlined, the four exception types would sit in the middle of Running's checks.
Session is the route table of the window's session: one arm per call of the plumbing, the two writes guarded to the window's origin, and the rest handed to the window's own api.

Serve runs what lives while the server serves: Listen picks the port, and FollowTheme, RecordCpu and Stop are what its thread and its timers run. It moved unchanged from the workspace's server. The handed code adds the two ifs that admit it and skip the window it replaces, beside the window they decide.

Reads is the window's route table: the path is the request itself, not a flag a caller chose, and each case is one named call; a case added here is one more line, never a branch that changes behaviour.

Acts picks the window's action by the request's path, a route table with one call per case and no logic of its own; the path is the request's own, not a flag the caller chose. The reload joins the table as one more case.
path is the request's own path: Page answers when it is one of the page's files and says false when it is not, so Route goes on to the API. No caller chooses a behaviour; the browser's request does.

from is the position the window read to, sent back as data; it picks no behaviour. Its one branch is the guard that reads from the first event when that position does not hold in this reading. live is data too: the text shown until the transcript holds it.

Start reads guard, resolve, return; Continued(string, string?) is the one rule of a moved session (its id, its window, the folder it ran in) and RanIn(string) is the transcript lookup under it, each a named step in plain ifs. This change adds one guard, that no session starts once a reload handed the sessions on.

Keyed is the route table of the keyed calls: one arm per call, read a session, start one, hand in a permission request, hand in a session's questions, and the refusal of any other. Its paths are the switch's arms and the tuple patterns they match on method and path; each arm is one call to the step that does the work.

WebCalls is the one HTTP vocabulary every server of brain speaks, all static and stateless: the boundary that answers a request and the helpers that send and refuse on one side, and reading the request's body on the other. Read and Body are one step, the body read whole by its length or to its end when chunked; they share no field with the senders because no method here holds one. Splitting the body read into its own class would move one method every server imports beside the others it imports from here.

AnswerProblem is the four rules an answer to one question keeps, each one plain guard in order: some answer, only its own options, one choice unless multiple, words only where it takes words. The rest of its paths are the ?? and || that read the fields the window may leave out. Split, the rules would scatter over helpers that each hold one if.

AskContract is the one contract of brain ask, kept in one place so the command and the server never disagree. One piece says what a document must say: Read, Checked, Problems and their helpers. The other says what an answer must say: ReplyProblem and AnswerProblem, plus the two texts the agent reads, Answers and Closed. Both are the shape of an AskQuestion, checked when it is asked and when it is answered; they share no field because the class has none.

Checked walks the document one level at a time and each helper checks one level of it: Problems the document, its wait and its list, QuestionProblems one question's text, recommend, why and multiple, OptionProblems its options' labels and the recommendation among them. Inlined, the three loops and their names would sit in one method of nested loops.

Parse is one parser of one transcript line, and its helpers are the kinds of block a transcript holds, one helper each: AddWords adds 3, At adds 1, Cut adds 1, DataUrl adds 5, FromAgent adds 7, FromUser adds 7, ImagesOf adds 4, InputOf adds 3, MessageId adds 1, Peer adds 4, ResultText adds 3, ToolCall adds 8, Whole adds 1 and WithImages adds 2. The count is the number of block kinds the transcript format has. This change adds the image block: ImagesOf finds the image blocks of a content array, DataUrl reads one with a guard per field it needs, and WithImages puts the user's images with his words.

View finds one agent and hands its facts to the view. NavaroneRuns.get counts the Bash results that ran Navarone, RunsNavarone(CodeEvent) is the one test of a call for it, Questions.get cuts a readiness check's report after its verdict, and TrailOf(Agent, List<Agent>, WorkSignals, Landings) builds the trail of the agent's work. Listing(Agent, List<Agent>) makes the agent's own listing. Each answers one question and none is a branch of View cut in pieces.

Read stays a short walk: calls, metas, agents, order. The ctor reads one agent's state, start, end and now; KindOf maps a type to a kind; NowOf(string-free) reads the last tool call or words; StateOf picks one of four states; Verdict reads the two words a check opens with; WorkOf finds the builder a brief names; FailedCalls collects error results; WithUnwritten adds a meta for a call with none yet. Each answers one question about one agent and none is a branch of Read cut in pieces.

Of tells one piece of work as its steps in time order, and its helpers are the voices of that story: BuilderSteps(Worker, HashSet<string>) cuts the builder's events into turns at each validator's message and numbers its words by turn, ValidatorSteps(string, Worker) takes the findings it sent and its report, InOrder(List<CodeStep>) orders the steps and numbers the findings, FindingsOf(CodeEvent, string) and CallsOf(IReadOnlyList<CodeEvent>, string) pick calls by tool, and Turn, with Take(CodeEvent), Called(CodeEvent), Gave(CodeEvent), Words() and FastForward(string), holds what one turn of an agent said, committed and landed. Each is one rule of the transcript's shape; inlined they would be one method doing the builder's, the validator's and git's reading at once.

Of reads the log and the disputes once the mark changed and caches the result per worktree. Ended(IReadOnlyList<NavaroneEvent>, IReadOnlySet<(string Worktree, string Id)>, string) takes the worktree's stories from the log's one grouping and marks those the disputes hold as clashes, and Story tells each: Take(NavaroneEvent) dispatches on the event type, one case a step, Named(NavaroneEvent) and Accepted() are two of those steps. The count is the story's rules, met one named step at a time.

Items reads a brain query's output by the shape of each line, and its helpers are the line shapes brain prints: IsRef adds 1, Item adds 4 for a ref line, an indented ref line and a walk's header, and Neighbour adds 5 for a walk's edge line. Inlined they are one switch over the shapes of brain's own output, which is the format, and the verb steers only the walk's header, which is no found node.

Reads is a flat route table of the window's reads: each of its ten cases is one call that sends what one read gives, and the default refuses any other path. Its cyclomatic count is its number of routes; this change adds the file explorer's three, places, a folder listed and an image read, each one call into ImageFolders. Splitting the table would scatter one list of the server's reads over two methods.

Checked(IReadOnlyList<CodeImage>?) is the list: a guard for none and a loop. Checked(CodeImage) adds 8 because it holds the five rules of an image claude takes, one guard each in the order they can be told: a media type Claude reads, base64, not empty, at most Largest bytes, and bytes that open as that type's. Inlined, the list would hold all five inside its loop; apart, each guard reads on its own.

End reads guard, resolve, return: a job gone answers false, a pid that is not one of claude's jobs is refused, then the family is asked to end, waited for, and what is left is read and killed, each a named statement. Each helper is one named step it repeats each round: Remember adds 3, adding the job and what is below it only while the job is still the process that started then, Alive adds 2, which remembered processes still run as themselves, and Signal adds 1, one signal to each. Inlined, the wait loop would hold two nested loops and the start checks, which is harder to read than the steps by name.

Acts is the window's route table: one case per endpoint, each a call to the handler of that path, with no logic of its own. A case that closes an ask joins it, as every endpoint did before it; its count is the endpoints, and a table of them is read straight down.

ReplyProblem walks the replies against the questions and AnswerProblem judges one question's answer: an answer with neither an option nor words, an option that is none of the question's, and several options for a question that takes one. Each is one rule of the contract, so inlined they would be the same checks in a loop body.

Listed makes one CodeSent per agent from facts that span agents. CheckedBy matches a check's brief, then falls to the next builder or validator sent; IsWork names the one test of those two kinds; OutlineOf shortens the steps PieceOf takes from Trail.Of. Each is its own question about one agent.

Serve is the server's life read top to bottom: take a handed code, start the listener or say the port is taken, open the window unless one moves here, accept until stopped, then land an answer in flight, stop every agent and start the successor. The eleventh path is the handed code, which stands beside the window it replaces; a helper for it would hide one if and add a name.
